definition: A subset A of Z/pZ is unique-sum-free when every element of A+A is the sum of at least two unordered pairs {a,b} from A (a=b allowed). m(p) is the smallest |A| of such a nonempty A.
source: OEIS A398173, examples for a(15)..a(20); each set found by the search engine and checked here against the definition
